source.validation: Exact public Git source at the fixed comparison revision. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
variants:
        - msix
        - a11y-checks
    run-on-projects:
        by-variant:
            msix:
                by-test-platform:
                    windows11-64.*: built-projects
                    default: []
            a11y-checks:
                by-test-platform:
                    linux.*64/opt: built-projects
                    default: []
            default: built-projects
    tier:
        by-test-platform:
            .*-asan.*: 2
            .*-ccov.*: 2
            .*-tsan.*: 2
            macosx1100.*: 2
            windows11.*: 1
            default: default
    chunks:
        by-test-platform:
            linux.*64-asan.*/opt: 16
            linux.*64-tsan.*/opt: 15
            windows1.-64.*-asan.*/opt: 9
            windows1.*-ccov.*/.*: 9
            .*/debug: 11
            default: 7
    mozharness:
        script: desktop_unittest.py
        mochitest-flavor: browser
        chunked: true
